name: code-review
description: Parallel two-axis diff review using fresh Antigravity subagents: Axis 1 checks repo standards (including optional CODING_STANDARDS.md) plus 12 Fowler code smells; Axis 2 checks spec fidelity plus a Reality-Check / Zero-Mock lens. Reports both axes separately without merging or reranking.
suggestedPrompts: Review my changes since main along both Standards and Spec axes
Run a two-axis code review since HEAD~3 against implementation_plan.md
Audit this branch diff for Fowler code smells and hardcoded mocks or fallbacks
